text: The subject is Fahad Mirza, who holds account PK**ABPA****6924 opened on 4 February 2023. The subject is declared to be a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 120,000 per month. Between 4 May 2026 and 29 May 2026, the account recorded 13 credits totalling PKR 20,109,000 and 5 debits totalling PKR 16,861,000. The account received 12 cash deposits totalling PKR 19,989,000 across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 29 May 2026, where the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scored 320 against an alert threshold of 300. 10 of 12 cash deposits (83%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 18,211,000, which is indicative of structuring to remain below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. The cash deposits were spread across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), a pattern consistent with suspected structuring. There was more than one cash deposit on 1 day (14 May 2026), which is consistent with suspected structuring. Credits in the activity window were 167.6 times the declared monthly income of PKR 120,000 per month, a volume inconsistent with the subject's profile and indicative of suspected structuring. The pattern of 10 of 12 cash deposits (83%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999 across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch) is consistent with suspected structuring to avoid the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. PKR 8,565,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C) in 2 transactions. PKR 4,952,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank C) in 1 transaction. PKR 3,344,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank B) in 2 transactions. Debits equal to 84% of credits were made with a median of 26.1 hours between the latest credit and each debit. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 30 May 2026. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision by L2 analyst on 30 May 2026.
